Extract and Display Structured Raster Metadata

Source: R/metadata.R
d4h_raster_metadata.Rd

Inspects one or more drone orthomosaics or raster layers and extracts comprehensive spatial metadata, including dimensions, data type, spatial resolution (GSD), georeferencing, bounding box, physical scene dimensions, and coordinate reference systems.

Usage

d4h_raster_metadata(x, quiet = FALSE)

d4h_metadata(x, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

x

Character file path, terra::SpatRaster, or list of file paths/SpatRasters.

quiet

Logical. If FALSE (default), prints a structured executive summary block to the console. If TRUE, suppresses printing.

Value

A data frame (tibble) of S3 class c("d4h_raster_metadata", "tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame") containing metadata attributes per raster layer or file:

file

Base filename or layer name

width

Number of columns in pixels

height

Number of rows in pixels

total_pixels

Total pixel count (width * height)

nbands

Number of raster channels/bands

dtype

Storage data type (e.g. uint8, uint16, float32)

nodata

Configured NoData value

res_x

Spatial resolution in X dimension

res_y

Spatial resolution in Y dimension

gsd_cm

Ground Sampling Distance in centimeters (if projected)

pixel_size_desc

Human-readable GSD description string

crs

Coordinate reference system description

epsg

EPSG code as integer

is_projected

Logical indicating whether CRS is projected in meters

xmin

Western boundary coordinate

xmax

Eastern boundary coordinate

ymin

Southern boundary coordinate

ymax

Northern boundary coordinate

width_m

Field horizontal width in meters

height_m

Field vertical height in meters

area_m2

Bounding box total surface area in square meters

area_ha

Bounding box total surface area in hectares

Details

Drone remote sensing workflows require exact spatial validation before index computation. d4h_raster_metadata (alias d4h_metadata) inspects GeoTIFF files or terra::SpatRaster objects, translating coordinate extents and pixel resolutions into human-readable metric dimensions (e.g., cm/pixel GSD, scene area in hectares, affine transformation coefficients).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)

  # Inspect metadata for a drone orthomosaic band
  path_r <- system.file("extdata", "ndvi.tif", package = "drones4health")
  meta <- d4h_raster_metadata(path_r)
  head(meta)
}
# }
